voice.footnote_other: Worked out on this Mac from your latest {{count, number}} dictations. Nothing leaves your Mac.

history.title: History
history.unavailable: History is not available yet. It appears as soon as the app has finished starting.

empty.body: Hold fn in any app and start talking. Every dictation is kept here, on this Mac.

history.resultsMore_one: The {{count}} most recent match. Scroll for more.
history.resultsMore_other: The {{count}} most recent matches. Scroll for more.
history.transcribeFailed: That file could not be opened. Please try again.
history.failed: Transcription failed. Try Retry transcript in the ⋮ menu.

audio.saveFailed: The recording could not be saved. Please try again.

history.copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Please try again.
history.actionFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
history.deleteFailed: That dictation could not be deleted. Please try again.
history.undoFailed: It is too late to bring that dictation back.

flag.title: Wrong word?
flag.description: Pick the word that came out wrong and type it the way it should be. Your dictionary fixes it from now on.
flag.pick: Pick the wrong word (pick the next one too for a few words)
flag.noWords: This dictation has no words to pick.
flag.correctionPlaceholder: Type it the way it should be
flag.ruleHint: Adds a replacement, so the same mistake is fixed in every dictation.
flag.wordHint: Adds the word, so the app can spot it when you say it.
flag.duplicate: That is already in your dictionary.
flag.failed: That could not be saved. Please try again.

scratchpad.addToBarHelp: Keep a Scratchpad button beside Dictate on the resting bar.
scratchpad.emptyHelp: Start a note, then type or dictate into its floating window.
scratchpad.error: Scratchpad could not complete that action. Your current text is still here; try again.

shortcut.label: Open shortcut
shortcut.title: Scratchpad shortcut
shortcut.help: Open Scratchpad from anywhere. It starts unset, so it never intercepts a key until you choose one.
shortcut.error: That shortcut could not be saved. Try another combination.

personal.label: Personal messages
personal.description: Chats with friends and family, such as Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and Discord.

work.label: Work messages
work.description: Chats with colleagues, such as Slack, Microsoft Teams and Google Chat.

email.label: Email
email.description: Email apps, such as Mail, Outlook, Spark and Superhuman.

other.label: Other
other.description: Every other app: notes, documents, code editors and more.

very_relaxed.label: Very relaxed
very_relaxed.description: Lower case at the start of sentences, lighter punctuation.

upbeat.label: Upbeat
upbeat.description: Full punctuation, with a little more energy.

style.englishOnly: Styles apply to dictations in English. Cleanup works in every language.

apps.heading: Used in these apps
apps.allOthers: Every app that is not in another group uses this style too.
apps.empty: No apps here yet. Add one with Add app.
apps.unavailable: The apps could not be loaded. They will appear when the app is ready.
apps.aiChat: An AI chat: your words go in cleaned, without a style.
apps.changeFailed: That change was not saved. Please try again.

picker.title: Add an app to {{group}}
picker.description: Pick an app on this Mac. Its dictations will use the {{group}} style.
picker.failed: The apps on this Mac could not be listed.

cleanup.description: How much your words are tidied up, in every app and every language. The style of each group is applied on top.

onboardingFlow.downloadHint: Speech setup continues in the background. You never have to wait for it here.
onboardingFlow.navigationFailed: That step could not be saved. Try again.

help.title: Help with setup
help.body: Each step takes a few seconds. You can go back at any time, and if you quit, setup picks up where you left off.
help.download: Wispr Bro sets up speech recognition on this Mac while you go through these steps. Anything you dictate before it is ready is kept and typed out once it is.

welcome.title: Talk, and your words appear
welcome.subtitle: Hold one key, speak, let go. Clean text lands wherever you are typing.
welcome.privacy: Your voice and your text never leave this computer. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
welcome.download: Speech setup starts now and runs in the background.

move.title: Move Wispr Bro to Applications
move.body: Wispr Bro is running from outside your Applications folder. Moving it there keeps updates and permissions working.
move.note: Wispr Bro reopens by itself after the move and continues setup.
move.error: Wispr Bro could not move itself. Drag it into Applications in Finder, then open it again.

languages.title: Which languages do you speak?
languages.subtitle: Pick every language you dictate in. Wispr Bro tidies your words much better when it knows them.
languages.count_one: Dictation works in {{count}} language. You can change yours later in Settings.
languages.count_other: Dictation works in {{count}} languages. You can change yours later in Settings.
languages.weak_one: Recognition is less accurate in {{languages}}. It still works, but expect more mistakes.
languages.weak_other: Recognition is less accurate in {{languages}}. They still work, but expect more mistakes.

permissions.title: Two permissions
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks you to allow these once. Each row ticks as soon as it is on.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.why: So Wispr Bro can hear you while you hold the key. Audio is processed on this Mac only.
microphone.promptAlt: Picture of the macOS microphone prompt, with the Allow button highlighted
microphone.paneAlt: Picture of System Settings, Privacy and Security, Microphone, with the switch for Wispr Bro turned on
microphone.waitingHelp: Click Allow in the macOS prompt. If you do not see it, open System Settings and turn on Wispr Bro under Microphone.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.why: So Wispr Bro can notice your shortcut and type the text into the app you are using.
accessibility.promptAlt: Picture of the macOS Accessibility prompt, with the Open System Settings button highlighted
accessibility.paneAlt: Picture of System Settings, Privacy and Security, Accessibility, with the switch for Wispr Bro turned on
accessibility.waitingHelp: In System Settings, turn on the switch next to Wispr Bro. You may need to unlock with your password.

mic.title: Test your microphone
mic.guidance: Wired and built-in microphones work best. Bluetooth headsets can drop out or sound muffled.
mic.question: Do the bars move when you talk?
mic.noHelp: Choose another microphone below, then talk again.

shortcut.title: Test your shortcut
shortcut.instruction: Press and hold the fn key (🌐) on your keyboard. The key below lights up while you hold it.
shortcut.fallbackInstruction: Press and hold Control and Option together. The keys below light up while you hold them.
shortcut.unboundInstruction: No dictation shortcut is set. Use Edit shortcut to choose one.
shortcut.worked: It works. The key lit up.
shortcut.question: Did the key light up?
shortcut.changeFailed: That change did not go through. Try again, or use System Settings.

tap.choice: Wispr Bro cannot see key presses
tap.title: Wispr Bro cannot see key presses yet
tap.body: This usually means Accessibility is not on for Wispr Bro. Turn it on in System Settings, then come back and press Try again.

secure_input.choice: A password field or another app is blocking keys
secure_input.title: Another app is blocking key presses
secure_input.body: While a password field or some apps (password managers, Terminal's Secure Keyboard Entry) have focus, macOS hides key presses from every other app. Close or click away from it, then try again.
secure_input.active: Right now, another app is blocking key presses.
secure_input.inactive: Nothing is blocking key presses right now.

globe.choice: The 🌐 key opens emoji or switches the keyboard
globe.title: macOS gives the 🌐 key its own job
globe.body: Your Mac opens emoji, switches input source or starts Apple dictation when you press 🌐. Wispr Bro can set “Press 🌐 key to” to Do Nothing. Your choice is put back if you stop using fn for dictation.
globe.changed: 🌐 now does nothing on its own

no_fn.choice: My keyboard has no fn key
no_fn.title: Use Control and Option instead
no_fn.body: Some keyboards have no fn or 🌐 key. Hold Control and Option together to dictate instead. You can change this any time in Settings.
